text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home after going out with 
Nishino Flower—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer, over there—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Nishino Flower 
was gazing, I saw a boy who looked quite 
young crouching all alone on the 
riverbank...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Are they alone? It's almost getting 
dark—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer... Would it be alright if I 
went and spoke to her?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—I see. You broke the cup Mom cherished so 
much, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... So... I thought Mom would be mad 
at me, and then, and then... *sniffle*... 
*sob*...—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...It's okay. You're safe now. You got 
scared and snuck out of the house, didn't 
you...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, watch this. I'm gonna show you 
something interesting.”

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Take this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having hidden them who knows where, 
Nishino Flower tosses her beanbags up into 
the evening sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And with brilliant sleight of hand, she 
catches and tosses it back up, tracing 
high, fast, and beautiful arcs—"

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: A-Amazing! Just like a circus performer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I can even do something like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spinning around and stepping side to side, 
she moved her body vigorously and 
dynamically, yet the beanbags never fell 
to the ground, dancing through the air 
again and again—

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
âThat was seriously amazing! You must be 
a professional beanbag juggler!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ I'm glad to see your smile back. 
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back to your mom together, 
okay? If you're scared, I'll apologize 
with you. I'm sure she's terribly worried 
about you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to walk the boy back 
to his home—
—Takkun!!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Mom...!

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness you're safe...! —I am so 
deeply sorry for the trouble my child 
caused you...!
choice_data_list:
No, I'm just glad we were able to meet 
safely.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Then should we tell Mom?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: "...Mom. I broke the cup... I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Dummy...! Tak-kun, you're way more 
important than that...! I was so worried 
about you...!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Ugh, u-uwaaaaaahhh...--

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After seeing off the parent and child, I 
resumed my walk back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Thank you for listening to what 
she had to say along with me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I was able to make up with 
Mom...
choice_data_list:
You were such a wonderful big sister out 
there, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
D-Do you think so? I was just, well, 
talking to them normally, but—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still... if that's how it looked to you, 
Trainer-san, that makes me really happy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our walk home was left memorable 
by Nishino Flower's warm and caring 
side...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Beanbag juggling is the one thing I'm 
fairly confident in. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A long time ago, when I was crying... my 
mother juggled beanbags for me, so...
choice_data_list:
You managed to do it just like your 
mother, huh?

You managed to do it just like your 
mother, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. But just the other day, that mother 
told me, "When did you get so good at 
this?" She was so surprised.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our walk home was left memorable 
by Nishino Flower's unexpected talent...
